inputs.text: The arrest and federal response are being staged as a public spectacle to keep everyone arguing about sanctuary policies. That’s the convenient story; the real question is who engineered the escalation and which institutions benefit from it. The supposed clash between opposing sides may be part of the same arrangement, keeping attention fixed on the political fight while the people pulling the strings stay out of view.
